title: Aligned but Flattened: Analyzing the Trade-off between Cultural Alignment and Diversity in LLMs

bias_targets.methodology: Role-play prompting using detailed cultural and socio-demographic personas and comparing model responses against the World Values Survey (WVS) to measure the trade-off between cultural alignment (matching group values) and cultural diversity (preserving heterogeneous, minority cultural viewpoints versus flattening into a dominant consensus).

Evaluating models using localized personas representing 14 different countries and measuring cross-country representational divergence to see if models accurately reflect local national values or anchor to a globally dominant reference.

Assessing alignment drops and marginalization risks for specific under-represented minority cohorts characterized by distinct socioeconomic attributes (e.g., marginalized social classes and education levels within the Nigerian population) before and after fine-tuning.
